mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in higher costs and potential Fed tightening.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in higher costs and potential Fed tightening.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth drops by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by HOUST, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in lower future demand.
failure_condition: HOUST drops by > 10% y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4%, an additional 25 basis point hike signals a hawkish Fed that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and rises by 25bp but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 5%, a sharp drop in retail sales, as measured by RSAFS, signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in lower future demand.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS drops by > 1% m-o-m while UNRATE < 5%
failure_condition: RSAFS drops by > 1% m-o-m while UNRATE < 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in payroll employment, as measured by PAYEMS, combined with a drop in the unemployment rate, signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in stronger consumer demand.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises by > 200k m-o-m while UNRATE drops but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index, as measured by CPIAUCSL, combined with a hawkish Fed funds rate above 2%, signals a high inflation environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in higher costs and potential Fed tightening.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises by > 0.5% m-o-m while FEDFUNDS > 2%
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises by > 0.5% m-o-m while FEDFUNDS > 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.
